skygo --json plan -f task.yaml
stdout '"target": *"chosen"'
! stderr .
skygo --json run -f task.yaml --request-id stable --wait
stdout '"cpu_limit_millis": *"200"'
stdout '"memory_limit_bytes": *"2048"'
stdout '"target_labels": *\{"pool": *"batch"\}'
stdout '"node_selector": *\{"zone": *"west"\}'
stderr 'request-id: stable'
skygo --json run -f task.yaml --request-id stable
stdout '"target": *"chosen"'
skygo info --target chosen --require resource-limits-v1,node-selector-v1,target-labels-v1
stdout 'resource-limits-v1,node-selector-v1,target-labels-v1'
! skygo run -f unknown.yaml
stderr 'field ignored not found'
! stdout .
! skygo run -f duplicate.yaml
stderr 'already defined'
! stdout .
! skygo run -f wrong-type.yaml
stderr 'cannot unmarshal'
! stdout .
# The old server ignores newer task fields. Discovery must fence both commands.
! skygo --endpoint $OLD_SERVER plan -f task.yaml
stderr 'unimplemented: server does not support capability discovery'
! stdout .
! skygo --endpoint $OLD_SERVER run -f task.yaml --request-id refused
stderr 'unimplemented: server does not support capability discovery'
! stdout .
-- task.yaml --
argv: [program, 雪]
env: {A: B}
target: chosen
cpu_millis: 100
memory_bytes: 1024
cpu_limit_millis: 200
memory_limit_bytes: 2048
target_labels: {pool: batch}
node_selector: {zone: west}
-- unknown.yaml --
argv: [program]
ignored: true
-- duplicate.yaml --
argv: [program]
node_selector: {zone: west, zone: east}
-- wrong-type.yaml --
argv: [program]
node_selector: [zone, west]
